title: publish gate: a validation rule comparing a text field with a number (record.name > 5) publishes with only a warning that says it "evaluates to null", then every write to the object is refused
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGDmSYVyFomEEAdU3

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing point and a reproduction (reach: `POST /api/v1/packages/PKG/publish-drafts` and the data door; reproduced on two boots, twice on the second, and once through Studio's Validations tab).
Business reason: an author writes a validation rule that compares a text field with a number, a common slip. Studio shows no verdict and autosaves; the publish succeeds and carries only a `warning` advisory saying the expression "silently evaluates to null". For a validation rule that is not what happens: rules fail closed, so from that moment every create and update on the object is refused with "could not be evaluated … write rejected". One typo takes the object's data entry down, and the gate's own message tells the author it is harmless.
Reader who acts: `domain:server`, the expression type judgment in `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` (the `type-mismatch` verdict at L349 is `severity: 'warning'` for every role) and the author-time gate that maps it for `validations[].condition`. The fail-closed evaluator is `packages/objectql` validation. The Studio half (no inline verdict) follows from the server's severity.
Dedupe (open and closed): `"no such overload"` 24 hits, `"could not be evaluated" validation rule` 25, `"type mismatch" validation` 24, `expression-invalid warning validation rule write rejected` 15. Nearest: #29026 (closed, the publish null-guard gate excluding flow conditions), #24720 (closed, a rule reading `parent` refuses every write), #24782 (closed, an unevaluable warning rule), #28944 (closed, date arithmetic passing the build gate). The nullable-number twin (`record.qty > 1000` on a nullable field) IS refused at publish today; the open #27482 covers Studio not holding that one. None covers a type mismatch that publishes.

QA-source: #29893 · studio-authoring.validation-rules-authoring · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Measured at framework `589049b0` (main, 2026-11-03) on a stock showcase boot, as admin, in a runtime package `P`.

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/orch_v4?mode=draft&package=P` `{"name":"orch_v4","label":"V4","sharingModel":"public_read_write","fields":{"name":{"type":"text","label":"Name","required":true}},"validations":[{"name":"name_gt","type":"script","condition":"record.name > 5","message":"bad","severity":"error"}]}` → 200.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages/P/publish-drafts` `{}` → **200** `outcome: published`, with one advisory, `rule: expression-invalid`, `severity: warning`, at `objects.orch_v4.validations[0].condition`, whose message reads: "type mismatch `string > int` — `record.name` holds text but is used with `>` against a number. This faults at runtime, so the expression silently evaluates to null (unless the value happens to be numeric). …"
3. `POST /api/v1/data/orch_v4` `{"name":"abc"}` → **400** `VALIDATION_FAILED`: "Validation rule 'name_gt' could not be evaluated (runtime: no such overload: dyn<string> > int) — write rejected." Every write is refused this way.

Through Studio (Validations → New → Reject the save when… → Expression → `record.name > 5`): no verdict at the input, two autosaves 200, no held line, and the same publish and write answers.

**Expected:** for a validation rule condition (a fail-closed role) the type mismatch is an `error` that refuses at save or at publish, as the nullable-comparison twin already is. If the warning stays for formula fields, where "evaluates to null" is true, its text should not be served for a role where it is false.

Control: the same field `required: false` gets the nullable-comparison verdict instead, and the publish is refused (`expression-invalid`, error).
